an5.100:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.100:1.3: tena kho pana samayena kakudho nāma koliyaputto āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno.
an5.100:1.4: tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho hoti: seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇivā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni.
an5.100:1.5: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena nevattānaṃ no paraṃ vyābādheti.
an5.100:2.1: atha kho kakudho devaputto yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho kakudho devaputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.100:2.4: sahacittuppādā ca bhante devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno”ti.
an5.100:2.6: idaṃ vatvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an5.100:3.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.100:4.1: “kakudho nāma bhante, koliyaputto mamaṃ upaṭṭhāko adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno.
an5.100:4.2: tassa evarūpo attabhāva paṭilābho hoti: seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni.
an5.100:4.3: so tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena nevattānaṃ no paraṃ vyābādheti.
an5.100:4.4: atha kho bhante kakudho devaputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhante kakudho devaputto maṃ etadavoca:
an5.100:4.7: sahacittuppādā ca bhante devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno’ti.
an5.100:4.9: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi”ti.
an5.100:5.1: kiṃ pana te moggallāna, kakudho devaputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito.
an5.100:5.2: yaṃ kiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati, sabbaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti no aññathāti?
an5.100:5.3: “cetasā ceto paricca vidito me bhante kakudho devaputto.
an5.100:5.4: yaṃ kiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati, sabbaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti no aññathā”ti.
an5.100:5.7: idāni so moghapuriso attanāva attānaṃ pātukarissatīti.
an5.100:6.1: pañcime moggallāna satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.100:6.3: idha moggallāna, ekacco sattā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:6.5: “ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:6.6: mayaṃ ceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:6.7: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathannu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma.
an5.100:6.9: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī”ti.
an5.100:6.10: evarūpaṃ kho pana moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti.
an5.100:6.11: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. (1)
an5.100:7.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṅkiliṭṭhoti.
an5.100:7.3: “ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṅkiliṭṭhoti.
an5.100:7.4: mayaṃ ceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:7.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathannu mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma.
an5.100:7.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī”ti.
an5.100:7.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti.
an5.100:7.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. (2)
an5.100:8.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddho me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhāti.
an5.100:8.3: “ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṅkiliṭṭhāti.
an5.100:8.4: mayaṃ ceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:8.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathannu taṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma.
an5.100:8.7: yaṃ tumo karissati, tumova tena paññāyissati”ti.
an5.100:8.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti.
an5.100:8.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati (3)
an5.100:9.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ paridotaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:9.3: “ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:9.4: mayaṃ ceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:9.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ kathannu taṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma.
an5.100:9.7: yaṃ tumo karissati, tumova tena paññāyissatī”ti.
an5.100:9.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna satthāraṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti.
an5.100:9.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati. (4)
an5.100:10.1: puna caparaṃ moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:10.3: “ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭijānāti, parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:10.4: mayaṃ ceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
an5.100:10.5: yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathannu taṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma.
an5.100:10.7: yaṃ tumo karissati, tumova tena paññāyissati”ti.
an5.100:10.8: evarūpaṃ kho moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti.
an5.100:10.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsati (5)
an5.100:10.10: ime kho moggallāna, pañca satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.100:11.1: ahaṃ kho pana moggallāna, parisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhīti paṭijānāmi, parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:11.2: na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti. na cāhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.3: parisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhīti paṭijānāmi, parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṅkiliṭṭhoti.
an5.100:11.4: na ca maṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti. na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.5: parisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadenomhīti paṭijānāmi, parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṅkiliṭṭhāti.
an5.100:11.6: na ca maṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti. na cāhaṃ sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.7: parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhīti paṭijānāmi, parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:11.8: na ca maṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti. na cāhaṃ sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmi.
an5.100:11.9: parisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhīti paṭijānāmi, parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhanti.
an5.100:11.10: na ca maṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti. na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsiṃsāmīti.
